items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: then I made an album here at the Hague, that nightclub across from the Ambassador Hotel, with Arnold Ross.

ctx.x: Yes, about the same money. Unless you double, you know, you go overtime, which is good. But if you get enough of them in a week, record dates, I used to do two,

sometimes I would do three in one day, you know. And after I -- oh, it was just so many artists around here I used to record with. And I did a lot of work with Shorty Rogers, you know. Did an album with him. Did albums with JATP for Norman , Ben Webster. Jimmy Rowles, Joe Mondragon, then I made an album here at the Hague, that nightclub across from the Ambassador Hotel, with Arnold Ross.
Oh, I remember that. That made quite a bit of noise, that album, in New York, as I remember.
